title: Optimize decision helpers — onboarding visuals and interactive screenshots
creator: Lena Ortega
description: Design and produce a set of onboarding visuals, annotated screenshots, and interactive microcopy for the Optimize toolkit. Focus areas: smart batching recommendations, prefix/KV caching guidance, and quantization profile chooser. Deliver a small set of hero screenshots, 3 interactive prototype states (baseline/recommended/advanced), and a handoff package for engineering and docs.
design_notes: Goal: lower time-to-value for engineers enabling cost/latency improvements via Optimize recommendations
Decision helpers should present trade-offs (latency vs cost vs quality) in a single-panel summary with a persistent ‘why this recommendation’ hover
Three recommendation tiers: Conservative (low risk), Balanced (default), Aggressive (cost-optimized). Each tier shows expected latency delta, cost delta, and quality risk score.
Include a compact quantization chooser with tooltips explaining INT8/FP16/quantized-4bit trade-offs and OS/hardware compatibility hints
Batching UI should surface target throughput, suggested batch size, and an estimated P95 latency impact for the customer’s observed payload distribution
Caching UI should demonstrate prefix examples and when not to enable caching (PII, variable prompts). Provide a toggle and a small visual of how KV cache reduces repeated token compute
Progressive disclosure: show summary card + a ‘Show details’ panel with plots (latency vs tokens, cost per 1k tokens)
Accessibility: ensure contrast ratios, keyboard focus states for toggles, and descriptive aria labels for recommendation chips
Localization: design space must accommodate longer German/Spanish strings; avoid fixed-width labels in screenshots
Screenshots should use anonymized telemetry data and a sandbox project name ("Acme-Pilot") to avoid customer PII
Dimensions: 1440x900 hero, 760x420 smaller cards for docs, mobile breakpoint 375x667 for condensed views
deliverables: Hero screenshot: Optimize > Recommendations dashboard (Balanced view)
Variant screenshots x2: Conservative and Aggressive recommendation states
Interactive prototype: 3-step flow (Observe -> Recommend -> Apply) in Figma with hover tooltips
Annotated handoff PDF with microcopy, aria notes, and image export names
Assets zip: PNG exports at 2x and SVGs for icons, plus raw Figma links
Short microcopy doc for docs team (30-60 words per tooltip)
